builds.name: Path Maker ceiling
builds.summary: W target-max-HP scaling uses .0002 bonus armor + .0002 bonus MR plus .08. Full All Out charge adds up to 80% of damage as true damage; resist purchases target the pre-conversion coefficient.
builds.goal: W target-max-HP scaling uses .0002 bonus armor + .0002 bonus MR plus .08. Full All Out charge adds up to 80% of damage as true damage; resist purchases target the pre-conversion coefficient.
builds.hypothesis:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for [0.4]-@MaxDuration.1@s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by [25]%. Then, he rams forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165] + [0.08 + (0.0002) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0002) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for [0.5]-[1.75]s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional [10]-[80]% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to [70]% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.
JakSho ramps both bonus resists; Force of Nature ramps MR; Randuin/Thornmail/Unending Despair add armor and Visage adds MR. These feed W resistance scaling. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

Stack JakSho/FoN then inspect stats before/after R; full W charge once, separately record physical/true packets. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Stored helper/statFormula or symbolic fields remain unresolved: validate live stat meanings/tick rules, do not silently infer. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Jak'Sho, The Protean, Force of Nature, Randuin's Omen, Thornmail, Spirit Visage, Unending Despair. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Partial damage adapters do not certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima. Select the exact supported form before using a separate calculator comparison.
